title: Disco and the thrill of a trumpet section

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: It isn't music. Listen, have you ever played anything yourself? You play trumpet? Well, you ought to know what I'm talking about, then. You ought to agree with me then. You ought to know then, you ought to know then. You understand.

I tell you, you get a thrill when you sit down and hear a guy play trumpet like Harry James or something or take a good corner on his trumpet, it gives you a lift, it gives you a lift. And see a trumpet section, how they work together. And you can hear the first, second, third and fourth trumpet just as plain. I get a kick out of that. I'd go anyplace just to hear them, because I know I can't play like they can now because I'm not physically able to. But I get a kick out of it. I'll always be interested in it. Always, as long as I live. Always.
